name: Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Ossiform Signal Lattice
description:
The Ossiform Signal Lattice is a network of piezoelectric filaments threaded through the periosteum of the long bones and integrated into the sternum and clavicles during a multi-stage surgical procedure. Rather than relying on conventional implanted hardware with its associated RF emission signatures, the Lattice uses the skeleton itself as a conductive signal medium — low-frequency data pulses travel through bone conduction pathways and are decoded by a small subdermal processor node seated at the base of the skull. The result is a near-undetectable internal data transmission and storage system that produces no electromagnetic signature detectable by standard sweep hardware.

Zheng-Dao's engineering breakthrough was discovering that the natural piezoelectric properties of cortical bone, when augmented with their proprietary bio-compatible filament weave, could carry structured data at meaningful bandwidths without interfering with normal skeletal function. The filaments osseointegrate within six to eight weeks, becoming functionally indistinguishable from the surrounding bone tissue on conventional medical imaging. Only Zheng-Dao's proprietary resonance scanner — and a small number of reverse-engineered black-market equivalents — can detect the lattice once integration is complete.

The Ossiform Signal Lattice is primarily a tool of the intelligence community, couriers operating in high-surveillance environments, and activists living under authoritarian corporate jurisdictions. It is the implant that most purely embodies GLMZ's central tension: the body as the last sovereign territory, the skeleton as the one place the city's surveillance grid cannot easily reach.

cultural_context: Among GLMZ's intelligence underground, having 'gone lattice' is a statement of commitment — the surgery is painful, the integration period leaves the subject in a compromised physical state, and the implant is effectively permanent without specialized extraction surgery that carries serious complication risks. It is both a practical tool and an identity marker. Corporate security divisions maintain classified protocols for handling lattice-implanted detainees, and there are documented cases of corporate security performing unauthorized 'deep imaging' procedures on suspects — a practice that has become a flashpoint in the city's ongoing debates about bodily sovereignty.
known_users: Data couriers in high-surveillance corporate districts
Mirela Koss, journalist and known Zheng-Dao contact
story_hooks: A deceased courier is brought to the crew — their body contains a Lattice loaded with data someone very powerful wants recovered, and three different factions are willing to do anything to be first to extract it.

A crew member discovers their skeleton has been latticed without their knowledge or consent during what they were told was routine orthopedic surgery — someone has been using their body as a data mule.
Zheng-Dao's proprietary resonance scanners are being quietly distributed to corporate security firms, threatening to collapse the entire operational security model that lattice users depend on.

A Lattice-implanted informant has gone dark inside a corporate facility — the crew must extract them before corporate security performs a 'deep imaging' procedure that will both burn the source and reveal who they work for.
